A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have shown that the Hamiltonian of particle dynamics near a resonance condition can be determined with high precision using the Fourier analysis of the island spectrum and that the nonlinear dynamics of the particle motion near a resonant condition can be understood using the Hamiltonian formalism.
we have shown the validity of the nonlinear beam dynamics theory for the Cooler Ring.
